en:
...That's my lab. Are you planning to take
a weapon for a little "persuasion"?

Shuichi! I want you to stop her with words,
not violence!

Do I really have to explain this to you!?
You really are a brainless degenerate!

If I wanted her to stop her by force, I'd do it
myself! Not ask a man for help!
Anyway, no weapons! Let's go, Shuichi!

We don't need weapons to convince her!
Let's go, Shuichi!

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...
